lead: A Federal High Court ordered the downstream regulator to keep issuing petrol import licences to AA Rano, Matrix Energy and another marketer. The government sought a new $1.5 billion World Bank loan, drawing criticism from Atiku Abubakar, and Sowore's AAC sued over President Tinubu's failure to hand power to the Vice President during his vacation. Kenya's President William Ruto toured the Dangote refinery, GTCO reported N603 billion half-year pre-tax profit, and gunmen killed three women at a mining site in Barkin Ladi.

items.h: Court orders NMDPRA to keep granting import licences to AA Rano and others
items.s: The Federal High Court in Abuja directed the regulator to continue issuing petroleum import licences to Matrix Energy, AA Rano and a third marketer.

items.h: FG seeks $1.5bn World Bank loan; Atiku demands accounting
items.s: The new financing would expand social protection, early childhood development and climate resilience. Atiku Abubakar said the government must first account for previous borrowing.

items.h: AAC sues over Tinubu's failure to transfer power to Shettima
items.s: Omoyele Sowore's party filed a suit at the Federal High Court in Abuja over the President's European vacation.

items.h: Ruto tours Dangote refinery as group targets $36bn revenue
items.s: Kenya's President called the refinery a masterpiece of engineering. Dangote Group expects $36 billion in revenue for 2026.

items.h: GTCO half-year pre-tax profit reaches N603bn
items.s: The bank declared an interim dividend of N1 a share.

items.h: Gunmen kill three women at Plateau mining site
items.s: Attackers stormed a mining site in Rakum community, Barkin Ladi, on Monday.

items.h: Court sets 13 October hearing on Atiku's motion to amend Tinubu suit
items.s: The suit challenges the President's eligibility for 2027.

items.h: Troops arrest suspected ransom couriers and rescue 14 in Katsina
items.s: Soldiers seized N2.7 million in suspected ransom money in Faskari.

items.h: Tinubu says credit guarantees unlocked N46.95bn in loans
items.s: The National Credit Guarantee Company issued N21.59 billion in guarantees.

items.h: FG targets one million outsourcing jobs by 2030
items.s: Vice President Shettima announced the export-linked jobs goal.

items.h: Shettima returns from UNGA after pressing Africa's case
items.s: He said Africa's exclusion from the Security Council undermines global governance.

items.h: JAMB restores CAPS and urges faster admissions
items.s: The admission system was back after a disruption.

items.h: ASUU suspends strike at Ondo state universities
items.s: The state government intervened in the dispute.

items.h: UBEC to begin 10-year basic education roadmap in October
items.s: The commission has digitised management of intervention funds.

items.h: Atiku backs labour's call for higher minimum wage
items.s: He said N70,000 has not restored workers' purchasing power.

items.h: Melaye says ADC would cut petrol to N400
items.s: The ADC chieftain defended plans to restore subsidy.

items.h: APM demands Okpebholo resign over fuel price remark
items.s: The party criticised the Edo governor for defending current petrol prices.

items.h: Kano governor says Tinubu must complete South's eight years
items.s: Abba Yusuf backed rotation of the presidency.

items.h: Makinde promises to reset Nigeria in four years
items.s: The APM candidate campaigned in Lafia.

items.h: NDC North-East candidates reject Babachir Lawal's appointment
items.s: Six governorship candidates opposed his role.

items.h: Imo APC calls Wike a threat to democracy
items.s: The PDP and Wike's aide hit back.

items.h: INEC, APC and Yahaya Bello ask court to dismiss senatorial ticket suit
items.s: An aspirant claims he won the 18 May Kogi primary.

items.h: DSS secures death sentence over Sokoto kidnap killings
items.s: Ibrahim Usman was convicted over the 2023 kidnapping and killing of three people.

items.h: DSS arraigns four over killing of operative
items.s: The suspected IPOB members are accused of killing officer Ekpeyong Owoh.

items.h: NDLEA destroys cannabis farms in Edo
items.s: Two plantations were destroyed in Esan South East.

items.h: Fire hits Customs Western Marine Command office in Apapa
items.s: An electrical surge started the blaze on Monday morning.

items.h: Reps panel writes CBN over audited accounts
items.s: The committee also wrote to special investigator Jim Obazee, KPMG and EY.

items.h: Court to rule on halting inquest into Adichie's son's death
items.s: A Lagos High Court will decide on 12 October.

items.h: Ground handlers to stop serving XEJet over N300m debt
items.s: The association directed members to withdraw services.

items.h: FAAN car age deadline threatens 300 airport taxi jobs
items.s: Operators must replace older vehicles by October.

items.h: CBN warns Kano traders against mishandling naira
items.s: Soiled notes are costly to replace, the bank said.

items.h: Usor eyes more after Super Eagles debut
items.s: Ethiopian officials will handle Tuesday's game in Bissau.
